name: TCU consolidated certificates API (Certidoes APF)
tier_rationale: Government body (A8 trusted): the Federal Court of Accounts issues the consolidated negative certificate (TCU inidoneos, CNJ CNIA, CEIS, CNEP) as an official public service; P239 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Official certificate service; trusted only when seCnpjEncontradoNaBaseTcu is true (a fictitious CNPJ also gets NADA_CONSTA) and per list only when the list answered (SISTEMA_INDISPONIVEL = unknown, P239 cond 2-3).

certidoes.title: TCU consolidated certificate API /api/rest/publico/certidoes/{cnpj}?seEmitirPDF=false (one call, four lists)

terms.quote: Terms classes (definitions for every chair file and registry entry): 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

certidoes.notes: Quote: binding A1 definition of 'open' (official public service, research C0545 'official public service (TCU)'). One keyless GET per CNPJ with the 14-character CNPJ in the path (the formatted CNPJ with '/' is decoded by the Apache front and answers a 404 HTML page, prep H9) and seEmitirPDF=false (live-verified spelling: certidaoPDF stays null, no PDF is generated). <= 1 req/s, cache 24 h (P239 cond 1). Used by tcu_certidoes.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G10-2 (P239). Single-batch host (owners.json maps certidoes-apf.apps.tcu.gov.br to no provider). ttl 86400 = sanctions class (P239 cond 1 'cache 24 h'). The answer can be TCU-cached (dataHoraEmissao a few minutes before the request): dataHoraEmissao is the 'as of' time. An alphanumeric CNPJ took 6.6 s live, hence timeout 15 s. .br host: Accept-Language pt-BR by default.
